verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include an API reference section with "Custom Integration Push APIs" (Integration Monitoring) and "Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs". Inbound webhooks also give each external system a unique endpoint URL for pushing data into ingestion workflows. The evidence is only page titles, though, and the documented scope looks limited to data push and a few read areas rather than full control of the product; probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec. Missing for 10: evidence of broad API coverage of core actions (controls, policies, risks, tasks, audits), auth and endpoint detail, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
